comment: Soundtrack pilot (openspec adaptive-soundtrack, plan/render-runs/soundtrack-pilot.md): the tour-1 carrier fight's sections, generated with ComfyUI core ACE-Step 1.5 nodes only. Each section is one text-to-music request: the committed campaign-text-headroom.json (acestep15-cue.json plus an 8 dB headroom trim before the FLAC save, so the decoder output never clips) plus $node overrides (studio.queue_workflow) on node 5 (TextEncodeAceStepAudio1.5) and node 7 (latent seconds). Grid: L5, 60632 samples per 4/4 bar at 48 kHz (189.9987 BPM). bpm_param is half the tempo with the real tempo in the tags (plan/audio-backend.md, metal-v2 finding). Keys: F minor, the victory sting F major.
